Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, redesign] Account Persistence Verification & Cloud Sync Screen: Redesigns the sign_in screen with a split layout showing instant account pet profile detection and sync status before logging in. (why: 8 support emails report pets missing or reset after signing in again, making cloud sync assurance critical during authentication.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Multi-Angle Photo Quality Preview & Alignment Flow: Introduces a two-column photo preview inspector flow on upload_photos with real-time asset alignment feedback and lighting checks. (why: 3 support emails report custom pet creation failing or looking wrong, contributing to the 71.1% dropoff rate at adoption.)
2: [home, layout] Interactive Pet Sound & Idle Reaction Teaser Grid: Transforms the waiting screen into an interactive grid layout featuring audio sound clips and idle reaction teasers while habitat loads. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s (median 201s), causing idle friction during background asset generation.)
3: [finish, hint] Companion Tray Minimize & Hotkey Reference Hint: Adds explicit hotkey shortcuts and taskbar tray controls hints to the home_intro screen. (why: Users reported confusion post-onboarding on how to hide, summon, or control pets on their desktop screen.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Desktop Companion Welcome Overview Copy: Updates story screen copy to clearly explain the floating desktop overlay pet concept right at entry. (why: High mean time on initial step (514s) indicates potential user confusion regarding what desktop pet functionality entails.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Data Privacy Assurance & Account Management Banner: Adds explicit data deletion and local memory control privacy guarantees to the sign_in screen. (why: 4 support emails requested account/data deletion and 8 had reset concerns, creating user hesitation around account linking.)
6: [home, notification] Background Asset Generation Desktop Notification: Enables desktop system notification alert switch when pet initialization finishes on the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s, causing drop-offs when users switch away to other apps while waiting.)
